$comment: Harness configuration. This file is reviewed code: the agent may only reference goal checks by name, never supply its own command. Lives in a subfolder because every *.json directly inside .github/hooks/ is parsed as a hook configuration.

checks.$comment: Named commands that /goal --check <name> may require. Exit code 0 means pass. Examples: "test": "npm test", "lint": "npm run lint", "build": "dotnet build --nologo", "pytest": "python -m pytest -q"

commands.reason: Recursive delete of the filesystem root or home directory.

This discards uncommitted work. Confirm with the user first.
Piping a download straight into a shell. Download, inspect, then run.
Skipping git hooks hides failing checks. Confirm with the user first.
